Market today: The mood is mixed for tech. While some signals suggest AI stocks might have bottomed, a major AI hedge fund just blew up, and Apple is facing supply chain issues. Fed rate hike talk adds a layer of caution, which typically pressures growth stocks like yours.

Your holdings: SOXL (-53.64%) and SPAL (-61.25%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay over time and their losses are amplified, especially on margin. QQQI (-5.89%) is also very close to its stop at 52.

Watch: Keep a close eye on overall AI sector sentiment and any further Fed commentary on interest rates. These will heavily influence your concentrated tech/chip book.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and deeply underwater positions, given your margin exposure.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF. Your -53.64% loss is significant, and the default stop at 200 is far from the current 117.97.
SPAL: Address this leveraged ETF immediately. Your -61.25% loss is extreme, and the stop at 21.38 is now well above the current price of 9.75, indicating a broken stop.
QQQI: Watch closely. Your current price of 53.09 is just above your 52 stop. Be ready to act if it breaks that level.
